Package org.eclipse.microprofile.reactive.streams.operators.spi

Interface Stage.Cancel

All Superinterfaces:
Stage
Enclosing interface:
Stage
public static interface Stage.Cancel extends Stage
A cancelling stage.

This stage immediately cancels upstream when it is run.

The CompletionStage produced by this stage must also be redeemed immediately with null.
